rationales: Correct: Oscar Hertwig discovered meiosis in 1876.
Incorrect: 1786 is not the year meiosis was discovered.
Incorrect: 1867 is not the year meiosis was discovered.
Incorrect: 1768 is not the year meiosis was discovered.
Correct: Prophase I is the longest phase of meiosis because it includes several substages and complex events.
Incorrect: Metaphase I is shorter than Prophase I.
Incorrect: Anaphase I is shorter than Prophase I.
Incorrect: Telophase I is shorter than Prophase I.
Incorrect: Ibn-e-Nafees did not propose the induced-fit model.
Incorrect: Emil Fischer is associated with the lock-and-key model.
Incorrect: Louis Pasteur did not propose the induced-fit model.
Correct: Daniel Koshland proposed the induced-fit model of enzyme action.
Incorrect: The stroma is where the Calvin cycle occurs, not the light reactions.
Incorrect: The light reactions do not take place in the cytoplasm.
Correct: The light reactions take place on the thylakoid membranes of chloroplasts.
Incorrect: Mitochondria are not the site of photosynthetic light reactions.
Correct: Defecation is the elimination of undigested food from the body.
Incorrect: Absorption is the uptake of digested nutrients into the body.
Incorrect: Assimilation is the use of absorbed nutrients by cells.
Incorrect: Ingestion is the taking of food into the body.
Incorrect: Two months is shorter than the average RBC lifespan.
Incorrect: Three months is shorter than the average RBC lifespan.
Correct: An RBC lives for about 120 days, or four months, on average.
Incorrect: Five months is longer than the average RBC lifespan.
Incorrect: 3.9% is not the salt concentration of blood plasma.
Correct: Blood plasma contains about 0.9% salts by weight.
Incorrect: 1.9% is higher than the salt concentration of blood plasma.
Incorrect: 2.9% is higher than the salt concentration of blood plasma.
Incorrect: A habitat is the place where organisms live, not the group described.
Incorrect: The biosphere includes all regions of Earth where life exists.
Incorrect: A community consists of populations of different species living together.
Correct: A population is members of the same species living in the same place at the same time.
Correct: Deductions are the logical consequences drawn from a hypothesis.
Incorrect: Observations are information gathered through the senses or instruments.
Incorrect: Experiments are procedures used to test a hypothesis or its deductions.
Incorrect: Summarization is not the term for logical consequences of a hypothesis.
Incorrect: Aristotle did not introduce the system of binomial nomenclature.
Correct: Carolus Linnaeus introduced the system of binomial nomenclature.
Incorrect: Ernst Haeckel did not introduce binomial nomenclature.
Incorrect: Robert Whittaker is known for proposing a five-kingdom classification system.
Incorrect: Stroma is the fluid-filled interior of a chloroplast.
Incorrect: The matrix is the interior compartment of a mitochondrion.
Correct: Cristae are folds of the inner mitochondrial membrane.
Incorrect: Thylakoids are membrane structures found in chloroplasts.
Correct: Chromosomes are duplicated during the S phase of interphase.
Incorrect: G1 is a growth phase before DNA replication.
Incorrect: G0 is a non-dividing state in which cells are not replicating DNA.
Incorrect: M phase is when the duplicated chromosomes are separated during cell division.
Correct: Chiasmata become visible during Prophase I, where homologous chromosomes have exchanged segments.
Incorrect: Metaphase I is when homologous chromosome pairs align at the cell equator.
Incorrect: Anaphase I is when homologous chromosomes separate.
Incorrect: Telophase I follows the separation of homologous chromosomes.
Incorrect: Enzymes are generally not carbohydrates.
Correct: Most enzymes are proteins.
Incorrect: Enzymes are generally not lipids.
Incorrect: Most enzymes are not nucleic acids, although some RNA molecules can act as catalysts.
Incorrect: 4300 calories is less than the energy released by one mole of ATP hydrolysis.
Incorrect: 5300 calories is less than the energy released by one mole of ATP hydrolysis.
Incorrect: 6300 calories is less than the standard approximate value.
Correct: One mole of ATP releases about 7300 calories (7.3 kilocalories) on hydrolysis.
